en.title: Health Clamped After Every Step
en.description:
The initial health is between 0 and 100. Add each change in order, clamping the result to [0,100] after every step, and output the final value.

This site's standard input/output is stated explicitly; ranges not given by the source are all marked as this site's protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n initial, and the second line contains n changes. The source gives no numeric ranges; on this site n is 0..100000, initial is 0..100, and changes are −10⁹..10⁹.
en.explanation: Example 1: the health goes 8, 0, 6, 8, so the output is 8. Example 2: it first reaches the cap of 100 and then loses 10, so the output is 90. Example 3: with no changes, it stays at 10.
hints: Simulate in order, adding and then clamping at every step.
